notes.title: Español & Português Translations Are LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[p][b]Spanish & Portuguese translations are in the game RIGHT NOW!!![/b]

It's also coupled with a 20% discount, so be sure to pick it up while it lasts =)

To access them:
1. Be on the Title Screen
2. Go to Settings
3. Click on the arrows around "ENGLISH" and all words should automatically and immediately change! 


Some important notes:
[/p][list][*][p] Keep in mind the language can only be changed from the Title Screen, not the in-game pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p] There are a couple places where the text hasn't been translated, most notably the early social media sites and posters, as some of the graphics and text is baked into the art itself and cannot be changed without re-drawing a lot of the piece.  However, this should not affect your understanding of the story at all.[/p][/*][*][p] The Spanish translation is in Neutral Spanish, so it should be accessible to both Spain and South American countries. It was done by Lisa Johnston and Pas Cabot (Punda Translations).[/p][/*][*][p] The Portuguese translation is specifically for Brazilian Portuguese. It was done by Enzo Costa. [/p][/*][*][p] Also, now that we've done all the groundwork allowing language switches, adding more languages should be a much easier and quicker process!  Relatively...
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Please let us know if there are any lines or text that doesn't make sense or is incomplete.  We did our best to get this ready for our inclusion in BIG Festival 2022, so it's possible we missed something!


And to anyone who has enjoyed Epiphany City enough to tell their non-English speaking friends, you are the real MVPs.

Thanks!
[i]- Dave[/i]

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/gFkvdFb.png?2"][/img]
[i]P.S. French, Simplified Chinese, and Korean are up next!  [/i][/p]

notes.title: Week 1 Patch Notes & Current Work
notes.content:
Hi.  Thank you all so much for playing or even just being interested in Epiphany City.  There is much more I could say about all the kind words and encouraging reviews we've received, but for now, let's just cut to the chase.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

Here are some of our next steps and patch notes we've done since the game came out.

[olist]
[*]Epiphany City's Original Soundtrack will most likely be available in a week.  It is [b]47 tracks[/b], including [b]13 bonus[/b] tracks and will cost [b]$4.99[/b].
[*]Epiphany City is currently being translated to [b]5 out of our 8 priority languages[/b], with more to come.
[*]We plan to add some thematic art to the sides of the screen to replace the black bars.
[*]Working on obtaining the Switch dev kit asap... not sure how much that matters to Steam folk but if you have friends that don't use Steam then you can let them know.
[*]When we start to receive some of the money from Valve we will talk about where our donations will be used.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

These are some of the major changes made since launch.  They are not all part of one update, but rather just a log of things that got fixed since the game came out.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't return to Bloom National Park if you left its first screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where the sides of the screen would turn white after certain cutscenes instead of black
[*]Math puzzles now solve properly even when many objects are moved and reset multiple times
[*]Many adjustments made to the Math puzzles in general
[*]Fixed a bug where framing a security camera and then getting seen by a different one would move the framed camera
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't drop the empty frame in a certain spot in the second security camera room
[*]If two camera lights are triggered simultaneously, the game will no longer trigger the 'caught' event twice
[*]The painting in the security camera area now properly resets its rotation upon triggering a camera
[*]An area towards the ending of the game no longer has a completely black screen
[*]Framed objects should appear on a layer above unframed objects more consistently
[*]Not a bug, but deleting or uninstalling vJoy has so far fixed most controller issues.  3Dconnexion was affecting the rest of the controller issues.
[/list]
We are aware of other issues and are working on them alongside our next steps.

___________________

Thank you for reading.  I always thought this was super cliche, but everyone who has played the game really is my hero.  You don't know how much everything has meant to me and how much everything helps us support our families.

Thanks again,
[i]- Dave[/i]

notes.title: Epiphany City: Prologue patch notes
notes.content:
For anyone who hasn't played Epiphany City yet (whether it be you or a friend), now is the best time to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593730/Epiphany_City_Prologue/][b]try it out[/b][/url]!


[b]BUT[/b] for those of you who already played the demo, this is you chance to do the following:

[h3]1. Post your review![/h3]
Now is your chance to finally review Epiphany City: Prologue and let your friends know what you think! It also helps us get the feedback necessary to improve the game and boosts our visibility for the almighty Steam algorithm.


[h3]2. Unlock the achievements![/h3]
There are only a couple for the Prologue, but don't miss the hidden one! 


[h3]3. Sign up for secret content![/h3]
Our down-to-earth newsletter gives you access to secret content such as Character Bios, Closed Beta tests, [url=https://imgur.com/CnyR7nI]infographics[/url], and more.  We also plan to add extra backstory cutscenes, exclusive art & wallpapers, "dungeon" design layouts, and even power level charts, but that will have to wait until the game's full release so we don't spoil anything =P  If that interests you, you can [url=www.epiphanycity.com/demo][b]sign up here[/b][/url].


For anyone who hasn't played Epiphany City yet (whether it be you or a friend), now is the best time to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593730/Epiphany_City_Prologue/][b]try it out[/b][/url]!


Our next beta test will be VERY SOONtm, pending art assets for the last couple screens.  If you want to participate, sign up at [url=www.epiphanycity.com/demo][b]EpiphanyCity.com[/b][/url]. Although this is only the Prologue, we are super excited to officially be releasing something on Steam!  Thank you so much for reading, and I hope you enjoy our game!

Love, 
[b]Team Epiphany[/b]
[i](Dave, Cam, KK, Romeo, Ellie, and Adorabelle & Cindy)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z7Wr4Hi.png[/img]

______________
[h3]Prologue Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] For keyboard controls, Z and X can now be used in place of E and R (Z = E, X = R)
[*] Added a Quit button to the Title Screen
[*] Fixed a typo on the Chapter Select screen
[*] The info card that pops up after you click 'Play Game' has been reworded for clarity.
[*] Adjusted cutscene dialogue to remove casual shorthand
[*] Added input buffering to smooth out the responsiveness of Lily's movement (despite our initial apprehensiveness, we were able to improve the movement slightly!)
[*] Reworked some Museum NPC dialogue
[*] Fixed a bug where certain dialogues could not be progressed with the "E" button
[*] Added an indicator to let players know that Running is possible in this game
[*] Replaced some animations to make them stand out more against their backgrounds
[*] Re-designed the Dog Painting puzzle for clarity and understanding
[*] Reverted the Prophecy's lines back to their original tone in older versions of Epiphany City
[*] Updated the Prophecy's cut-outs during the Burnt Down Museum cutscene to match the new lines.
[*] Added some VFX to the Sacred Prophecy and Silly Villains cutscenes.
[/list]
